concepts.label: Intervals
semanticSeeds: distance between two notes
numbered note relationship
concepts.definition: Intervals name a note by its distance and role inside the current key.

concepts.label: Major triads
semanticSeeds: root third and fifth
three note major harmony
concepts.definition: A major triad contains the root, major third, and fifth.

concepts.label: Minor triads
semanticSeeds: lower the third of a major chord
root flat third and fifth
concepts.definition: A minor triad lowers the major triad's third by one half step.

concepts.label: Dominant 7
semanticSeeds: major chord with a lowered seventh
root third fifth and flat seventh
concepts.definition: A dominant-seven chord adds the flat seventh to a major triad.

concepts.label: Major 7
semanticSeeds: major chord with a natural seventh
root third fifth and seventh
concepts.definition: A major-seven chord adds the natural seventh to a major triad.

concepts.label: Dominant 7 flat 9
semanticSeeds: dominant chord with a flat ninth
flat nine added to dominant seven
concepts.definition: A dominant-seven-flat-nine sound adds the flat ninth above a dominant-seven foundation.

concepts.label: Diatonic harmony
aliases: chords that relate to a key
semanticSeeds: chords belonging to one key
build a chord on every scale degree
concepts.definition: Diatonic harmony organizes the chords and notes that naturally belong to a key.

concepts.label: Nashville numbers
semanticSeeds: name chords by scale number
transpose the same chord functions
concepts.definition: Nashville numbers describe chord function relative to the current major key.

concepts.label: Pedal functions
semanticSeeds: what the pedal changes
before and after interval role
concepts.definition: Pedals and levers change interval roles; familiar licks are musical results of those changes.

concepts.label: Pick blocking
semanticSeeds: return the pick to stop the note
stop a ringing string with the picking finger
concepts.definition: Pick blocking ends a note by returning a picking finger or thumb to the string deliberately.

concepts.label: Right-hand independence
semanticSeeds: one finger moves while the others stay still
remove unnecessary hand movement
concepts.definition: Right-hand independence keeps resting fingers quiet while one digit picks or blocks.

concepts.label: Bar accuracy and intonation
semanticSeeds: center the bar over the fret
listen for accurate pitch
concepts.definition: Bar accuracy combines a centered landing, stable pressure, and listening for pitch against the musical context.

concepts.label: Pockets and positions
aliases: notes on either side of this position
semanticSeeds: nearby notes around a chord position
look left and right from a position
concepts.definition: A position is a home area; a pocket includes nearby chord tones, scale tones, and usable connecting notes.

concepts.label: Chromatic pathways
semanticSeeds: half step connector between destinations
use every fret to approach a target note
concepts.definition: A chromatic pathway uses nearby half-step motion to connect stable musical destinations.
